title: 第一卷 第11章 吸收了污染的灵力，一点事都没有？
content_zh:
“你这样吃太没滋味了，来，大口吃，使劲嚼，唔·····啊！唔·····啊！”

    见陈昭宁吃得慢条斯理的，陈渊当即摆出一副狼吞虎咽的模样，活像饿极了的乞丐，示意她跟着学。

    陈昭宁忍不住弯了弯嘴角，笑意刚浮上来，又连忙压了下去。

    她不再拘谨，想了想，还是学着陈渊的样子大口吃了起来。

    “这就对了啊，就算这东西普通，不是那么好吃，但也要吃得香甜，吃着吃着，不知不觉就吃完啦。”

    “吃完了，就饱了，饱了，就会让心情好一点。”

    陈渊说着，脸上绽开一抹爽朗的笑容。

    “好像……确实有点道理。”

    陈昭宁耳边回响着他的话语，低头见手中的鸡腿已然剩下骨头了，不由得微微一怔。

    看着油腻腻的手，脏兮兮的，正发愁该如何擦手的时候，又一只鸡腿粗鲁地递到了面前，塞在了她的手里。

    “再来一个啊！”

    陈昭宁抬眼，撞进陈渊灿烂的笑脸里，那双眸子明亮又清澈，格外动人。

    陈渊身上裹着破旧的棉袄，好几处还用布条胡乱捆扎着，模样看着活脱脱一个小乞丐。

    可此刻在她眼中，对方的双眼却胜过暖阳，让人心底泛起阵阵暖意。

    “你的眼睛……真的很好看。”

    陈昭宁不自觉地喃喃，话音刚落，才反应过来。

    这是在夸一个男生啊，我怎么失去了矜持？

    一时间，她的脸颊烧得滚烫。

    她急忙转过身，背对着漆黑的洞壁。

    一旁啃着鸡脖子的陈渊笑出声：“你的桃花眼才叫好看呢，打小就是个美人胚子，长大以后，怕是要成为祸国殃民的仙子咯。”

    听着身后的调侃，陈昭宁脸颊更热，轻啐一口：“呸，胡说八道，谁会祸国殃民了？”

    沉默片刻，她又低声补了一句：“祸乱妖国尚可，绝不会伤及无辜百姓。”

    “······嗯？”

    陈渊没听清后半句话，面露疑惑。

    可陈昭宁不愿再搭话，只顾低头啃食鸡腿。

    陈渊见状也不再追问，把手里的鸡骨头啃得干干净净。

    一顿吃食下肚，他体力恢复了大半，先前的疲惫尽数消散。

    陈渊随手用脏旧的棉袄擦了擦油腻的双手，随即盘膝而坐，运转《玄黄正气诀》开始修炼。

    没过多久，身侧传来窸窸窣窣的动静，像是有人在扯自己的衣角。

    他睁开眼，就见脸颊泛红的陈昭宁，正拿他的衣服擦手。

    “呃……反正你衣服本来就脏，也不差这一下，等回了陈家，我赔你一身新衣裳便是。”

    说完，她像受惊的小兔子般飞快收回手，抱起身旁的长刀，再度对着洞壁不语。

    陈渊哑然一笑，并未在意。

    衣服本就肮脏，擦手也无妨。

    他转头看向一旁睡得正沉的李伟和糯米，又望向神色若有所思的陆承锋，笑着略显尴尬地开口：“陆大叔，要不要也来点？就剩些骨头了。”

    “我不吃。”陆承锋倚着洞壁，声音淡淡传来，“倒是挺会讨姑娘欢心。”

    陈渊摸了摸鼻子，轻咳两声，只好重新静心修炼。

    身后的陈昭宁听见这话，低声嗔道：“油嘴滑舌。”

    陈渊没有再接话，尽数开启灵窍，引动周身灵力化为法力，流转四肢百骸。

    背过身的陈昭宁倦意袭来，也渐渐沉入梦乡，不再理会身后打坐的少年。

    山洞内夜色沉沉，火堆里的木柴噼啪作响，火光摇曳，映在众人身上。

    有陆承锋守在洞口，众人都睡得格外安稳，陈渊也得以安心修炼。
content_en:
"It's so tasteless when you eat like this. Come on, eat big, chew hard, uh... ah! uh... ah!"

    Seeing Chen Zhaoning eating slowly, Chen Yuan immediately looked like a hungry beggar, gesturing for her to follow suit.

    Chen Zhaoning couldn't help but curl the corners of his mouth, and as soon as his smile appeared, he quickly suppressed it.

    She was no longer restrained, thought about it, and started eating like Chen Yuan.

    "That's right. Even if this food is ordinary and not that delicious, it still has to be delicious. Eat it and you'll finish it before you know it."

    "When you eat, you feel full. When you feel full, you feel better."

    Chen Yuan said, with a hearty smile on his face.

    "It seems...it does make sense."

    His words echoed in Chen Zhaoning's ears. He lowered his head and saw that there were no bones left in the chicken drumstick in his hand, and he couldn't help but be slightly startled.

    Looking at her greasy and dirty hands, and just when she was worrying about how to wipe them, another chicken drumstick was roughly handed to her and stuffed into her hand.

    "One more!"

    Chen Zhaoning raised his eyes and ran into Chen Yuan's bright smiling face. Those eyes were bright and clear, which was particularly moving.

    Chen Yuan was wrapped in a worn-out cotton-padded jacket and tied randomly with strips of cloth in several places. He looked like a little beggar.

    But at this moment, in her eyes, the other person's eyes were better than the warm sun, making people feel warm in their hearts.

    "Your eyes...are really beautiful."

    Chen Zhaoning murmured unconsciously, and he didn't react until he finished speaking.

    This is praising a boy. Why have I lost my reserve?

    For a moment, her cheeks burned hot.

    She turned around quickly, facing away from the dark cave wall.

    Chen Yuan, who was gnawing on the neck of a chicken, laughed out loud: "Your peach blossom eyes are so beautiful. You have been a beauty since you were a child. When you grow up, I am afraid that you will become a fairy who will bring disaster to the country and the people."

    Listening to the ridicule behind him, Chen Zhaoning's cheeks became even hotter and he spat lightly: "Bah, that's nonsense. Who will bring disaster to the country and the people?"

    After a moment of silence, she added in a low voice: "It's okay to cause trouble to the demon country, but it will never hurt innocent people."

    "...Huh?"

    Chen Yuan didn't hear the second half of the sentence clearly and looked confused.

    But Chen Zhaoning didn't want to talk to him anymore, he just lowered his head and ate the chicken legs.

    When Chen Yuan saw this, he stopped asking questions and gnawed the chicken bones cleanly.

    After a meal, he regained most of his strength, and all the previous fatigue dissipated.

    Chen Yuan casually wiped his greasy hands with a dirty cotton-padded jacket, then sat cross-legged and started practicing by running the "Xuanhuang Zhengqi Jue".

    Not long after, there was a rustling movement beside him, as if someone was tugging at the corner of his clothes.

    He opened his eyes and saw Chen Zhaoning, whose cheeks were red, wiping his hands on his clothes.

    "Uh... Anyway, your clothes are already dirty, so it's not bad. When you get back to Chen's house, I'll give you a new pair of clothes."

    After saying that, she quickly retracted her hand like a frightened little rabbit, picked up the long knife beside her, and faced the cave wall again without saying a word.

    Chen Yuan smiled dumbly and didn't care.

    The clothes are already dirty, so there is no harm in wiping your hands.

    He turned to look at Li Wei and Nuomi, who were sleeping deeply, and then at Lu Chengfeng, who looked thoughtful, and said with a slightly embarrassed smile: "Uncle Lu, do you want some too? There are only some bones left."

    "I won't eat." Lu Chengfeng leaned against the cave wall and said in a faint voice, "He is quite good at pleasing girls."

    Chen Yuan touched his nose, coughed twice, and had to practice quietly again.

    Chen Zhaoning, who was behind him, heard this and muttered in a low voice: "Glib tongue."

    Chen Yuan did not answer any more words, and opened all his spiritual orifices, activating the spiritual power throughout his body to turn into mana, flowing through his limbs and bones.

    Chen Zhaoning, who turned his back, felt tired and gradually fell into sleep, no longer paying attention to the young man meditating behind him.

    It was dark inside the cave, the wood in the fire crackled, and the light of the fire swayed, reflecting on everyone.

    With Lu Chengfeng guarding the entrance of the cave, everyone slept very peacefully, and Chen Yuan was able to practice with peace of mind.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 11 Absorbing contaminated spiritual power, nothing happens at all?
